Overview

About the Control Center Data Center Edition

ASUS Control Center Data Center Edition is a unified management platform for HPC, AI and enterprise infrastructure. From one dashboard it monitors hardware health, power and carbon emissions, automates updates and secures mixed server fleets.

It works out-of-band through the ASMB BMC on ASUS servers and scales to thousands of nodes.

Real-time monitoring

Hardware, sensor, VM and storage health with proactive alerts.

Automated patching

Update BIOS through OS across thousands of nodes in a few clicks.

Power and carbon reporting

Node, rack and facility power with monthly carbon reports.

Security controls

Multi-factor authentication, RBAC, IP access control and audit logs.

POD View

3D visualisation of the server room to find free space and failed hardware.
